regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 entries 1–15 and footnotes
regions.finding: Fifteen independent optimization runs were retained with the shared 1a/2a scale, catalyst/solvent deviations, PPh3 footnote additions, DCE overrides, 25 °C, CH2Br2 NMR basis, product yields, 1a recoveries, and universal non-observation of 3aa'.

regions.region: page 2 center-right Table 2 entries 1–5 and footnote
regions.finding: Five N-substituent scope rows were inventoried. Entries 1/2 are the same 1a/1b experiments as Table 3 entries 1/2 and were merged; entries 3–5 remain separate Bn/PMP/H experiments with isolated yields and diene non-formation.
Narrative discussion introduces the Table 3 electronic/steric scope. It is linked to the individual page-3 rows and does not create prose-only duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Table 1 reaction times and isolated yields are absent.
Most scope rows omit reaction time, atmosphere, workup, purification, and product mass.

regions.region: page 3 left Table 3 entries 1–27 and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Twenty-seven distinct scope rows were retained with R1/R2/PG labels, carbonate identity encoded by product label, row-specific 0.6/0.5 mmol or 1.2/1.0 mmol conditions, entry-16 reversed 0.5/0.6 mmol condition, MeCN volume, 25 °C, Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol%, and isolated yields. Rows 1/2 are cross-listed Table 2 experiments and not duplicated.

Five independent 1D/2b conditions were retained with exact displayed mmol values, optional Cs2CO3, temperature/time, double-product NMR yield, zero single-product yield, 1D recovery, and entry-1 parenthetical 76% isolated yield.
Four separate failed or complicated trials were retained: 2c/1h gives no 3hc with 58% 1h recovery; 2d/1h is complicated; 1E/2b and 1F/2b give no products with 81%/80% 2b recovery.

The soft/hard nucleophile paths are cited prior-work classes, the 1h/2b-d2 arrow is a distinct current isotope control, and η1/η3/int I/int II are proposed mechanistic species rather than preparations.

unresolved: Table 3 rows omit reaction time and most operational details.
Scheme 2 omits reaction time, solvent volume, workup, and detection limits.
Mechanistic intermediates and isotope-resolved product structures remain unverified.

regions.finding: The soft-nucleophile allene path and hard-nucleophile diene path are cited literature classes, not current-paper reaction runs.
A distinct 1h (0.6 mmol)/2b-d2 (0.5 mmol, >99% D) experiment with Pd(PPh3)4 5 mol% in MeCN at 25 °C for 12 h gives 3hb-d2 in 94%, >99% D; 3hb'-d2 is not observed.
η1-dienyl-Pd, η3-int I, int II, O-attack and 3,3-rearrangement-type reductive elimination form a proposed mechanism; the alternative direct η3-int-I path remains author-stated uncertainty.

The detailed 1a/2a experiment was merged into Table 3 entry 1: exact masses/mmol, argon, sequential charging, 25 °C/5.5 h, TLC, short silica/60 mL ether workup, 15:1 chromatography, and 246.7 mg/90% isolated product were added.
